title: 78 Months: The Scam Courier YouTubers Caught on Camera

lines.say: Seventy-eight months in prison, for the cash courier YouTubers confronted on camera.
lines.show: 78 months in prison, for the cash courier YouTubers confronted on camera.

lines.say: In July twenty twenty-three, Jiandong Chen, called Little Tiger, came to collect cash he thought was from an elderly victim.
lines.show: In July 2023, Jiandong Chen, called "Little Tiger," came to collect cash he thought was from an elderly victim.

lines.say: Trilogy Media confronted him instead. One point four million views.

lines.say: Prosecutors say he kept going until federal agents encountered him that December.
On November thirteenth, with both YouTubers in court, a San Diego judge sentenced him.
